fish.name: Wisp Minnow
fish.flavor: Barely more than a rumor with fins. Schools of them drift past like thoughts you almost had.

fish.name: Candlefin Dace
fish.flavor: Its dorsal fin burns a soft tallow-yellow that never gutters, even underwater. Old cavers navigate by them and tip their hats in payment.

fish.name: Tiptoe Loach
fish.flavor: It creeps along the cavern floor on its fin-tips, very quietly, as if the rocks were sleeping. They are not. Probably.

fish.name: Dripstone Dab
fish.flavor: Flat, patient, and speckled like wet limestone. It has been waiting under that ledge since before you were born, and it can wait longer.

fish.name: Penny Wisher
fish.flavor: Gleams like a coin tossed down a well. Catching one is said to grant the wish of whoever threw it, which is awkward, because it wasn't you.

fish.name: Grumblegill
fish.flavor: Complains constantly in a register only bats can hear. The bats have filed several noise complaints.

fish.name: Glowworm Gulper
fish.flavor: Leaps for dangling glowworm threads and misses nearly every time. The glowworms find this hilarious.

fish.name: Chime Tetra
fish.flavor: Schools of them brush the crystal columns as they pass, ringing faint arpeggios. Cave musicians tune to them.

fish.name: Murmur Carp
fish.flavor: Mouths silent words at the surface all day. Lip-readers report it is mostly asking for bread.

fish.name: Hushfin Sculpin
fish.flavor: So quiet on the line that anglers often forget it is there, then apologize to it out loud. It accepts.

fish.name: Cobweb Dace
fish.flavor: Trails filaments of pale silk it definitely did not spin. Nobody has met the spider, and nobody is asking to.

fish.name: Echo Smelt
fish.flavor: Call out across the water and it arrives seven seconds later, sounding slightly like you.

fish.name: Bindlefish
fish.flavor: Carries a smooth travelling-pebble in its cheek wherever it goes. Ask where it's headed and it will look away, embarrassed.

fish.name: Mossbell Gudgeon
fish.flavor: Wears a little cap of soft cave moss, grown on purpose. When it swims quickly, the cap flutters like a tiny green bell.

fish.name: Knocker Smelt
fish.flavor: It raps the cave wall three times before biting. Miners say always tap back; it's rude otherwise, and unlucky besides.

fish.name: Fibbing Eel
fish.flavor: Claims to be a much larger eel that simply isn't trying today. Under oath, it will admit to being a ribbon with opinions.

fish.name: Second Shadow
fish.flavor: It swims exactly beneath your reflection, matching your movements a half-beat late. Try not to think about it.

fish.name: Backwards Trout
fish.flavor: Swims tail-first with total confidence. It has seen where everything is going and prefers where it has been.

fish.name: Borrowed Bream
fish.flavor: Every scale on it belongs to a different fish, none of them consulted. It insists it will return them all eventually.

fish.name: Milkmoon Molly
fish.flavor: Pale as moonlight that got lost underground and settled in. It waxes and wanes with the month, and no one has ever seen it new.

fish.name: Yawning Blenny
fish.flavor: Its yawn is contagious across species lines. Whole expeditions have been lost to naps.

fish.name: Gossip Gourami
fish.flavor: Presses its ear-fins against the crystal veins to hear conversations three caverns away. It knows what you said. It isn't telling. Yet.

fish.name: Misplaced Perch
fish.flavor: Nobody knows how a perch got down here, least of all the perch. It has decided to make the best of things.

fish.name: Widdershins Gar
fish.flavor: Circles the cavern lake counterclockwise, always, unpicking some very old knot. On the solstice it pauses, considers, and continues counterclockwise.

fish.name: Grandmother's Teeth
fish.flavor: A mouthful of perfectly ordinary molars arranged in a warm, familiar grin. Folk say it collects whatever children leave under their pillows, and pays fair.

fish.name: The Ferryman's Change
fish.flavor: Flat, cold, and stamped with a face nobody living recognizes. Keep two of them, the story goes, and you will never need them.

fish.name: Whistling Bones
fish.flavor: Translucent skin over a skeleton that whistles old mining songs into the current. It only knows the sad ones, but it whistles them cheerfully.

fish.name: Prism Skulker
fish.flavor: Hides among the crystal clusters and refracts itself into a dozen identical fish. Only one is real, and it is never the one you would guess.

fish.name: The Housekeeper
fish.flavor: Tidies the lakebed every night, arranging pebbles by size and sentiment. Disturb its work and it will follow you home to critique yours.

fish.name: The Uninvited Guest
fish.flavor: It arrives in your net whether or not you cast for it, dressed in its best scales. It knows exactly what you were fishing for, and it is hurt, frankly, that it wasn't this.

fish.name: Wyrmcandle
fish.flavor: A wyrm no longer than your arm, wearing a flame that has never once guttered, even underwater. Old maps mark its pool with a small drawn candle and the single word 'polite.'

fish.name: Hymn of the Hollow Hill
fish.flavor: When it glides overhead, the glowworms dim in reverence and the crystals hold one long, low chord. Anglers remove their hats without deciding to.

fish.name: The Long Dark
fish.flavor: Not merely an eel in the dark; the dark, in an eel. Where it swims, lantern light politely declines to follow, and no one has ever seen all of it at once.

fish.name: Bell of the Drowned Chapel
fish.flavor: A verdigris-scaled giant that tolls once, deep and bronze, the moment it is hooked. Somewhere far above, an empty chapel answers.

fish.name: The Unlit Star
fish.flavor: A star that lost its footing and fell all the way through the roof of the world. It does not glow; the cave glows around it, out of respect, and landing it feels like holding the moment just before a wish.
